name: moodlog
description: Daily mood log: rate the day 1-5 with an optional note, see the 7-day average with per-day emoji list, and a week-over-week trend once enough days are logged. Supportive replies, never a diagnosis; distress language always points to people and emergency services.
route: rate my mood, mood 1-5, day was good/bad, my mood this week, weekly mood, mood trend, how have I been feeling
